hypotheses.justification: The statement never uses `[CharP k p]`. On the `k` side it only mentions `algebraMap k R` and `EllipticCurveGeom (Spec (.of k))`. The only characteristic-dependent term is `iterateFrobenius R p n`, which needs `ExpChar R p`, and that comes from `[CharP R p]` and `[Fact p.Prime]`. The hypothesis is only used in the proof, through `iterateFrobenius k p n` and the helper lemma `TauCeti.exists_iterateFrobenius_eq_algebraMap_comp`. It can be derived from the remaining hypotheses: `R` is nontrivial because of `[IsLocalRing R]`, and `k` is a field. Mathlib's `RingHom.charP_iff_charP` (Mathlib/Algebra/CharP/Algebra.lean) takes `{K L} [DivisionRing K] [NonAssocSemiring L] [Nontrivial L] (f : K →+* L) (p)` and gives `CharP K p ↔ CharP L p`. So the proof can start with `haveI : CharP k p := (RingHom.charP_iff_charP (algebraMap k R) p).mpr inferInstance` and then run unchanged. The converse does not work: `[CharP R p]` cannot be deleted instead, because `iterateFrobenius R p n` in the statement needs `ExpChar R p` from instance search.
